mechanistic_change: Reachable permitted label evidence expands from one edge to two-edge walks; a query with no one-hop anchor can then receive evidence from a two-hop TRAIN anchor. This changes accessible information support in the correction operator.
prediction: May help only if additional reachable TRAIN labels are informative and the extra propagation does not introduce misleading evidence or dilute competent corrections. No gain follows from the support expansion alone.
proposed_operator: delta_m(i)=O_m sum_j alpha_m(i,j) V2_m sum_k beta_m(j,k) V1_m e_m(y_k)*1[k∈A\Q], with bias-free linear label-value maps and feature-only scores from detachedH. No unmasked cached field enters either pass.
scaling: For a fixed old-state mask-independent linear-in-label-value two-hop operator, the existing conditional(n-1)/(n-k) multiplier is applied once at the initial label source, not once per hop. Message first moments alone do not make probabilities/losses/gradients unbiased. Echoless-LP retained-label renormalization is not silently substituted.
statement: Conditionally replace the one-hop label-value operator by two sequential mask-independent feature-scored, linear label-message passes. Zero every commonQ label before the first pass and recompute the entire label-derived intermediate field after each mask. Keep nativeH/base detached, own corrected CE and the predetermined pool.
title: Two-hop literal-label-echo-free correction with protected native learning
